fusions.name: Bearing Down
fusions.desc: Strikes one enemy within 5 tiles. The blow deals 15 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Word
fusions.desc: Strikes one enemy at or below 25% health and deals 18 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Compelling Stare
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pressing Advantage
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 40% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
